saw_lines: Refurbished laptop buyers check specs, battery and warranty, and trust the seller that answers those first.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether this seller is worth a click.
Your 30 live ads show no proof number, so buyers have nothing to weigh. Collect one figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has nothing to weigh before clicking. Collect one figure, like review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

15 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product, so the click gets lost. Point each one to the category it shows: iPhone ads to a refurbished iPhone page, laptop ads to the laptop page.
Your 20 copy ads carry no offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in the opening line of three new ads and make it the reason to click.

13 different openings run across your 20 copy ads. Buyers see a new message each time, so the brand does not settle in their mind. Build the next batch from the two best, the laptop warranty line and the iPhone line.

ads_1: Laptop warranty openers and a first order offer, tested against the iPhone line
